# Power-Up Armory · Boss Rush Tycoon

> A gamified commerce application where customers purchase equipment, weapons, and tactical power-ups to unlock progression in an arcade boss-rush tycoon RPG.

## Overview
Power-Up Armory bridges dynamic e-commerce with real-time browser combat. Players purchase or earn tactical buffs, weapons, relics, and consumables with volume-discount pack pricing, then redeem receipt keys to empower heroes in battle against epic multi-phase bosses.

## Key Modules
- **Storefront & Armory**: 5 distinct gear categories (Weapons, Defense, Agility, Consumables, Specials) with bulk pack discount milestones and receipt generation.
- **Boss Rush Gauntlet**: Battle legendary bosses (Neon Serpent, Obsidian Titan, Chrono Lich, Void Emperor) with active skills, attack timers, particle effects, and phase mechanics.
- **Receipt Key Redemption**: Cryptographic verification bridge that credits items and bonus gems directly into player armory accounts.
- **Tycoon Mining Engine**: Auto-mining crystal generators, passive gem generation, and armory upgrades.
- **Global Leaderboards**: Cloud-synchronized high scores, boss clear times, and player stat tracking with Firebase Firestore.

## Endpoints & Key Files
- `/` - Main interactive application interface
- `/robots.txt` - Search and crawler rules
- `/llms.txt` - LLM context and architectural overview
- `/llm.txt` - LLM specification alias
- `/sitemap.xml` - XML site map
- `/site.webmanifest` - Web application manifest

## Technical Stack
- **Framework**: React 18, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Database / Auth**: Firebase Firestore & Firebase Authentication
- **Icons**: Lucide Icons
- **Animation**: CSS animations, Canvas VFX, Web Audio Synthesizer
